request: Keep DAILY stock/weight decisions. Explicit turnover controls, no momentum, no deferred5-day review.
frozen_model: Use daily reselected Bayesian H5/W1008,p0=.55,strength=.5,cap=.10,lambda3; matched equal differs only strength0.
execution_limits: Ordinary actual executed buy+sell notional divided by pretrade NAV <=10% each day and <=50% or100% summed across trailing20 trading days. Proportionally scale ordinary orders at execution; never fabricate full fills. Membership exit or closing nearness<.80 is emergency liquidation exempt. First execution day initial funding exempt. All actual trades INCLUDING exceptions enter published turnover and costs. Exceptions logged separately.
hold_rules: Entry remains nearness>=.90 and top10%. Compare ordinary exit thresholds nearness<.88/.85 or rank>top25%; require2/3 consecutive valid daily breach observations. Unknown data resets breach streak but preserves an already pending sell. Emergency exits have no confirmation delay. No time-expiry exit.
other_controls: 3/5 trading-day cooldown after actual full exit. No discretionary weight trade if difference<=max(.5/1.0 percentagepoint,20%currentweight), except exit/stock-cap target trims. Freeze small trades before scaling desired increases to cash-feasible target sum<=1. New slots available only after actual exits; executable holding count<=20. No guarantee to stay fully invested while budgets bind.
grid: 2 exit-near x2 confirmation x2 cooldown x2 band x2 rolling20budget =32 packages. Daycap10%,relativeband20%,exitrank25%,emergency80% fixed. Compare previous uncontrolled daily implementation as separate baseline.
selection: Fit2009-2013 require positiveCAGR and annual buy+sell turnover<=15NAV; validation2014-2016 positiveCAGR,turnover<=15,and MDD no more than5pp worse than uncontrolled daily baseline. Top5 fit Sharpe, choose highest validation netSharpe, tie lower turnover/name. If none pass label unqualified and choose most promising diagnostic under available turnover constraints. Freeze before2017+ outcomes. Annual15 is selection criterion, not guaranteed cap because urgent exits exempt.
evaluation: All accounts flat start2017-01-02, test2017-2021,recent2022-2026July; no resets2022. Data already repeatedly studied. Report no-control daily, controlled Bayes, matched controlled equal, and fixed default package(.88,3days,5cooldown,1ppband,20day50%) for comparison. Do not replace chosen package using recent returns.
validation: Actual daily and rolling20 ordinary budget sums, emergency/initial accounting, quantity/cash/NAV reconstruction, every-day decisions, causal confirmation/cooldown, no capped fill increase, stock count, next-close orders, future prefix checks, costs13/25bp and recovery0.
